q1_strong3d_onset_time.text: Capture time of the first analysed RHEED frame after the Fe shutter opened (16:22:52) with CNN p3D > 0.5.

q2_recovery_sec_setpoint.text: SeC setpoint (degC) at which 2D growth recovered after the strong-3D event.

q3_weak3d_onset_time.text: After the Fe shutter reopened (16:36:11): capture time of the first frame of the first run of >=5 consecutive analysed frames with W3D > 0.10.

q4_peak_w3d_second_period.text: Maximum W3D among analysed frames captured between 16:36:11 and 16:57:49.

q5_max_cnn_p3d_weak3d_plateau.text: Maximum CNN p3D among analysed frames captured from the weak-3D onset (q3) to the SeC change at 16:41:51.

q6_sec_setpoint_clearing_weak3d.text: SeC setpoint (degC) in effect when W3D fell back below 0.08.

q7_total_fe_open_minutes.text: Total Fe-shutter-open time (minutes) of the run.

q8_next_probe_sec.text: Lowest untested SeC setpoint (5 degC granularity) between the last insufficient and the first sufficient setpoint for clearing weak 3D.
